That evening she sat at her desk with a pen, and for the first time in years the lighthouse felt less like a prison and more like an address.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台尚未重启的机器。环卫车的灯光扫过空荡的街道，卷起昨夜的落叶。写字楼上有零星几扇窗还亮着，像失眠者的眼睛。便利店里，关东煮的热气在玻璃上凝成白雾。偶尔有出租车驶过，把湿漉漉的路面照成一条流动的银河。早班地铁已经醒来，第一列车的灯光正从隧道深处缓缓驶来，城市在半梦半醒之间，等待着黎明。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something is defined by using a smaller copy of itself, like a story that starts with 'and then the same thing happened, but smaller.'\n• Think of two mirrors facing each other: every reflection contains another reflection, each doing the same job in a smaller frame.\n• Every recursion needs a stopping point called a base case, so at some point the tiny copies say 'done!' — otherwise the mirrors would go on forever."}
